objective: R2C de solo lectura para certificar en EDARSAHUB SQL la fuente canonica de inventarios fisicos y el catalogo canonico de almacenes. No usar POS LIVE, Mongo, DDL, DML, hardcodes ni estructuras paralelas. Obtener evidencia suficiente para fijar el linaje Unidad de Negocio -> Almacen -> Inventario Fisico y preparar el parche anti-regresion.

queries.name: unidades_negocio
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (100) id, codigo, nombre, server_id, sucursal_origen_id, system_type, activo FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio ORDER BY nombre;

queries.name: inventory_sync_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: inventory_sync_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows FROM dbo.Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync;

queries.name: warehouse_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name IN ('Inventario_Almacenes','Sistema_Almacenes','Almacenes','Compras_Almacenes_Sync','Inventarios_Almacenes_Sync') ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: warehouse_columns
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.Inventario_Almacenes'), OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Almacenes'), OBJECT_ID('dbo.Almacenes'), OBJECT_ID('dbo.Compras_Almacenes_Sync'), OBJECT_ID('dbo.Inventarios_Almacenes_Sync')) ORDER BY table_name, c.column_id;
